5 social psychology facts
i'll never forget

1. the spotlight effect

people notice your mistakes
far less than you think.

2. the pratfall effect

a competent person becomes
more likeable after a
small slip.

every fact like this changes
how you see people.
learn one a day.
slides.texte_sophia:
every fact like this changes
how you see people. i learn
one a day on an app
like Sophia.

slides.texte_overlay:
3. the bystander effect

the more people watch, the less
likely anyone helps.
so be the one who does.

4. the halo effect

one good trait colours how
we judge everything else.

5. the zeigarnik effect

we remember unfinished tasks
better than finished ones.

which one surprised you?
save this.
